$comment: The MCP servers the template can configure. /init writes .mcp.json from the entries whose capability the project selects, each one as its command and args here, and adds each one's <package>@<version> to the project's root devDependencies as an exact version; pnpm mcp:docs reads this file to refresh the generated block of docs/mcp.md and to report pin bumps, and verify:mcp-docs holds the entries, the block and .mcp.json to it. Each command is pinned and direct (decision 61): node runs scripts/mcp/launch.mjs <name>, which reads this entry and imports node_modules/<package>/<entry> in the same process, with serverArgs, the server's own arguments, after it. That is one process per server instead of four (cmd.exe, conhost, the npx launcher and the server), no network fetch when a client starts it, and every version old enough for pnpm's minimumReleaseAge (1,440 minutes), which an unpinned npx -y bypasses. area is web or mobile and nothing else: the launcher starts a server only when ATL_MCP_AREA, a comma list such as web, mobile, web,mobile or none, names its area, and every server when the variable is unset or empty, so a session opened from a Claude Desktop environment of one area starts only that area's servers. See docs/mcp.md.
